top_signals.title: U.S. strikes Iran after surprise missile attack, dashing hopes of de-escalation
top_signals.summary: The U.S. forces began launching strikes against Iran Wednesday stateside, plunging the two sides back into open conflict after a days-long pause.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China’s Launch of Advanced Hypersonic Missile Hints at Wider Use
top_signals.summary: China revealed for the first time the launch of the YJ-20 missile from a smaller destroyer, paving the way for one of its most advanced hypersonic weapons to be deployed on the fleet of vessels.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
